text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The one who triumphed in the fierce battle 
was Mr. C.B. Her boundless freedom and 
sheer joy in racing moved the entire 
audience.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The young channel administrator was swept 
up in the jubilation as well. He realized 
that it was precisely because Mr. C.B. 
enjoyed racing that he was able to dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. basks in the afterglow of the 
race, savoring the sensation of running on 
the glittering turf over and over again. 
—And then, she started running once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the "mythology" told in later years, 
everyone would say in unison: There was an 
Umamusume named Mr. C.B., who lived more 
freely than anyone else.
